renderium.options.sr.enabled.tooltip: Enable AI-powered super resolution (DLSS/FSR/NIS) for higher resolution output at lower performance cost.
renderium.options.sr.technique.tooltip: Select the super resolution technology to use. DLSS requires NVIDIA RTX GPU, FSR works on all GPUs.
renderium.options.sr.quality.tooltip: Balance between visual quality and performance. Higher quality uses more GPU resources.
renderium.options.sr.resolution_scale.to: Internal rendering resolution as a percentage of output resolution. Lower values improve performance but reduce clarity.
renderium.options.sr.sharpness.tooltip: Post-processing sharpening filter strength (0.0-1.0). Higher values enhance edge clarity.
renderium.options.fg.enabled.tooltip: Use AI to generate intermediate frames, doubling or tripling effective framerate. Requires compatible GPU and VSync disabled.
renderium.options.fg.mode.tooltip: Select the frame generation algorithm. DLSS-FG requires NVIDIA RTX 40 series or later, FG-X is experimental.
renderium.options.fg.multiplier.tooltip: Number of AI-generated intermediate frames. 2x = 1 intermediate per real frame, 3x = 2 intermediates.
renderium.options.reflex.enabled.tooltip: Reduce system latency for faster response times. Recommended for competitive gaming.
renderium.options.reflex.mode.tooltip: Balance between latency and power consumption modes.
renderium.options.reflex.show_markers.to: Display real-time PC and render latency indicators in screen corners.
renderium.options.culling.enabled.toolti: Hide occluded (invisible) blocks, dramatically reducing geometry processed by GPU.
renderium.options.culling.aggressiveness: Conservative/aggressive balance of culling algorithm. More aggressive = better performance but potential visual artifacts.
renderium.options.lod.enabled.tooltip: Automatically reduce detail of distant chunks based on distance, significantly reducing polygon count.
renderium.options.lod.distance_multiplie: Global scale factor for LOD distance thresholds. Higher values = earlier detail reduction = better performance.
renderium.options.lod.chunk_fade_range.t: Transition distance (in blocks) from low LOD to full LOD for newly loaded chunks. Larger = smoother but more VRAM usage.
renderium.shader.preset.tooltip: One-click switch for all shader effects. Selecting a preset auto-adjusts all parameters below to recommended values. 'Balanced' is recommended for most users.
renderium.shader.shadow_quality.tooltip: Controls shadow clarity and render distance. Higher quality needs more VRAM but produces softer, more natural shadow edges.
renderium.shader.shadow_distance.tooltip: Maximum shadow coverage distance in blocks. Greater distances consume more performance.
renderium.shader.ssao_quality.tooltip: Simulates ambient light occlusion in corners and creases, adding depth perception. Moderate performance impact.
renderium.shader.gi_bounces.tooltip: Number of light bounces between surfaces. 0 = disable global illumination, 4 = most realistic but very expensive.
renderium.shader.bloom_intensity.tooltip: Glow effect intensity around bright light sources. Increase for cinematic feel; too high causes glare.
renderium.shader.tonemap_mode.tooltip: Controls how bright areas map to screen, affecting overall image style and color reproduction.
renderium.shader.vignette.tooltip: Gradual darkening around screen edges, enhancing visual focus. Mimics natural camera lens vignetting.
renderium.shader.skybox_type.tooltip: Sky background rendering method. Procedural sky automatically changes color with time of day.
renderium.shader.cloud_quality.tooltip: Cloud rendering method. Volumetric clouds have realistic 3D light scattering for best visuals.
renderium.shader.pbr_enabled.tooltip: Physically-based material rendering giving realistic reflections and roughness to metal, water, leather surfaces.
renderium.shader.rt_reflections.tooltip: Use ray tracing for mirror reflections. Requires RTX-class GPU, significantly improves water/metal realism.
renderium.shader.auto_exposure.tooltip: Automatically adjust exposure based on scene brightness. Disable for manual control when pursuing specific artistic styles.
